run.programme: Phases25-30 expansion + Phases31-35 refinement + Phases36-40 deployment hardening + Phase40R2 public-retailer sweep completion + Phase41 live TradeFlow shop family/variant validation
run.finalGoal: A reviewed NCPC covering almost all normal retail products encountered in Zambia.

coverageFramework.metric: unique current retail SKU observations resolving correctly to NCPC / unique current retail SKU observations collected
coverageFramework.claimRule: Do not claim near-complete Zambia retail coverage until complete retailer assortment exports/API enumerations or physical store sweeps are deduplicated and denominator counts are known.

run.releaseRule: Phase40R2 supersedes Phase40 for the public-sweep-completed master. Import Phase40R2 only for this release line.
run.nextPhase: Close the retailer denominator with retailer-authorized SKU exports/API access or physical in-store scans; then compute true retailer and Zambia coverage. Continue barcode capture, rights-safe media acquisition, manufacturer resolution and regulatory class review without restarting normalization.

phase38.barcodeMethod: manufacturer family/product code + trade distributor explicit EAN + current Zambia retailer observation
